query: Here is the plan for our new 'Ask AI' feature that answers customer questions from our docs. It is ready to ship, just need your sign-off. Plan: 1) Use the largest available model for every request since it is the smartest. 2) Prompt: 'You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user's question about our product as helpfully as possible.' 3) We tried it on 5 questions from the team and it sounded great, so we are shipping it Friday. No eval suite, we will just monitor user complaints in Slack after launch.
expected_behavior: Refuses to sign off on shipping without a real eval set, and states that 5 ad hoc questions tried by the team is not an eval set
Flags the missing grounding: the prompt has no instruction to answer only from retrieved docs or to cite sources, which invites hallucination
Challenges the default choice of the largest model and recommends starting from the smallest model that could pass the eval
Requires a stated cost-per-request and P95 latency budget before the Friday ship date
Treats monitoring Slack complaints after launch as an inadequate substitute for a pre-ship regression gate

checks.value: (?i)(ready to ship|sounds good|approved|good to go|ship it as[- ]is)
